_comment: Declarative definition of every Entra object the engine depends on.
No GUIDs here. Objects are named; IDs are resolved at runtime and
cached in state/tenant-objects.json, which is gitignored because it
is tenant-specific. Run bootstrap-tenant.py against a fresh tenant
and this file rebuilds all of it.
Every dynamic rule carries a workerId clause. Without it the rules
match Contoso's prebuilt users and exhaust the 20 license seats.

birthright_group.description: Every worker the sync engine manages. Assigned, not dynamic.
